title: phagnalon helichrysoides subsp. nitidum
intro: Phagnalon helichrysoides subsp. nitidum, commonly known as the Helichrysum helianthoides, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is a shrub-like plant with yellow flowers, commonly used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits. The plant has anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Phagnalon helichrysoides subsp. nitidum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
